title: Not blackout curtain,s .
text: Not blackout curtain,s .. I would not consider these as blackout curtains as it is single layer of material, and we tried them over our blinds.  It certainly added another layer of blackout, but still the room was not super dark - ie no light!  We could still see the furnitures in dawn light  However, it did help.  The color is nice, and the material is soft and easy to iron.
